rows.words:
Amendment to (R362) for b752, on the author’s word; it adds sources to Components 2 and 3 and rewrites nothing already banked or committed.

(5)(i) gains its sources. Before any declaration of SIDE-kernel is graded, read at HEAD and cite the FINDINGS entry “The inheritance census: every compiled statement in the federation that mentions a zero of zeta or xi, by kind, with the per-class dichotomy for SIDE-kernel’s seven classes” (the b751 mirror’s :4885; its table of the seven classes :4908-:4918; “What the census earns about the catalogue” :4920; “The two engines” :4922). The statements bank re-reads those declarations at v1.5 and says, class by class, whether the census’s reading stands at the tree; it does not rebuild the table.

(5) also reads, whole: relay data/b726_mechanisms.txt (the mechanism table of W-ORD-MECHANISM-TABLE: row 1, class-group averaging, with its mechanism sentence, its instance and the kernel’s witness), data/b723_c2_closed_form.txt as that row cites it, and data/b732_beurling_read.txt; and SIDE-kernel at its current tag beside v1.5: dh_witness (Kernel/Cascade/SieveCeilingWitness.lean :94 as data/b710_r5_controls.txt :110 prints it), printed whole with the definitions its statement names and graded from its statement.

(6) opens, before any price, with what those two records already establish about the order’s question, by line: what a class is as the kernel states it, and what mechanism the record names for the zeros of Z_Q0. The plan then says whether the order as entered (OPEN_TRAILS :17932) asks for anything they do not already answer, and prices T0-T3 against that reading.

The navigator’s defect, CLAIM, NEW, lettered in the corrigendum: the order was proposed at b746 and (R362)(5)-(6) were written with neither record read.

The readfirst bank gains these paths; the (W) list is regenerated with this amendment’s row; if Component 2’s banks are already committed, the additions go in a further bank of this act, data/b752_statements_sources.txt, committed before the plan is drafted.

rows.words: Renamed: the sitting next, taking the fixes the navigator’s read of 2026-11-10 turned up (the front-door sentence re-cut, the Epstein document’s class and the map’s wording, the stage text of canon XXIII, the criterion cluster’s seat, the three criterion rows graded), with the mirror builder’s repairs beside it; then the Epstein document’s sections 6, 7 and 8 in one act; the build of the plan’s recommendation after them if the plan passed.

rows.clause: (R362) the act after this one (ferry :25, :29, :49), the order of acts after b752: amends row 2 (the system refresh first, then the sitting, then sections 6-8, then the build if [P1] passed)
rows.words:
Amendment, on the author’s word, to the order of acts after this one.

The act after this one is the system refresh, ahead of the sitting: the keystone census’s cluster table re-read live by its own form as its next edition (every registry row since 2026-10-07 placed, the criterion kernel and its documents given their row, each cluster’s kernels at their current tags); the kernel list reconciled against the SIDE-* directories on D: (the census names 36 kernels, the pins roster 37, the August count was 43); the two shelves D:\PLACE-phase1.5 and D:\PLACE-phase2 listed against PLACE-papers with nothing written, each file SAME, OLDER, NEWER or ABSENT; HANDOFF.md at the relay root, frozen at 2026-09-03, rewritten from those reads as the restart page or retired on the author’s word at that act; and a route for the mirror tool to export one cluster’s documents at their newest editions.

Then the sitting as banked, its cluster item cut from the refreshed table; then the Epstein document’s sections 6, 7 and 8; then the build if the plan passed.
